capabilities: Create per-folder rules that assign properties to new notes
Define property values using native Obsidian property types (text, number, checkbox, date, tags, list)
Merge folder tags into notes that already have tags without overwriting them
Track folder renames and moves so rules update automatically
Build nested sub-rules in a folder-tree settings UI or from the file explorer context menu
extras: Manual installation only (no community plugin store instructions); requires Obsidian v1.1.1 or higher; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: To keep the vault organized without the friction of manually typing out tags, checkboxes, and metadata every time a new file is created.
problem: Obsidian requires manually typing tags, checkboxes, and metadata on every new note, which is repetitive when folders should always carry the same properties.
summary: Rule-based plugin that automatically applies predefined frontmatter properties to new notes based on the folder they are created in.
